decisions.quote: The current research sought to systematically replicate Smaby et al. (2007) and Cividini-Motta and Ahearn’s (2013) use of the MSA, speci ﬁ cally to evaluate the relative reinforcing ef ﬁ cacy of the individual components of a token economy in a brief assessment.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly state that they replicated Smaby et al.'s (2007) use of the multiple-schedule reinforcer assessment (MSA) procedure in a new application evaluating token economy components, and only note the general viability of the method rather than comparing against a specific empirical finding of Smaby et al. (2007). Shipped's 'mixed' misinterprets heterogeneous responder profiles across the four learners in the new sample as a replication comparison.
